referenceSources.title: Trans Am Championship Winning Rocketsports Jaguar XKR for Sale in SEBRING, FL | RacingJunk
referenceSources.description:
A championship-winning Rocketsports Jaguar XKR, painted dark green with red accents and numbered 77, is staged under a paddock tent at a racing venue. The car features Goodyear Eagle tires on BBS wheels, a large rear wing, and Trans Am series decals. It is equipped with a fresh Promotor D3 358 ci engine rated at 850 HP, a new Hewland wide 5-speed gearbox, and a G Force 9" transmission, all with minimal hours.

The sale listing highlights an extensive spares package including a C3 spare engine, spare transmission, and two extra sets of rims. Located in Sebring, Florida, the private seller accepts cash trades and offers shipping through Thrifty Auto Shipping, with storage options via SpareFoot Storage.
